mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_trigger_settings(user_id,weekly_enabled,monthly_enabled,import_enabled,import_days,source_name,notify_in_app) VALUES(#{userId},#{settings.weeklyEnabled},#{settings.monthlyEnabled},#{settings.importEnabled},#{settings.importDays}, #{settings.sourceName},#{settings.notifyInApp}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE weekly_enabled=#{settings.weeklyEnabled},monthly_enabled=#{settings.monthlyEnabled}, import_enabled=#{settings.importEnabled}, import_days=#{settings.importDays},source_name=#{settings.sourceName},notify_in_app=#{settings.notifyInApp}
mapper.select: SELECT s.user_id FROM agent_trigger_settings s JOIN profiles p ON p.user_id=s.user_id AND p.ai_consent=TRUE AND p.ai_sleep=TRUE JOIN users u ON u.id=s.user_id AND u.enabled=TRUE JOIN system_settings g ON g.id=1 WHERE (s.weekly_enabled AND g.weekly_enabled) OR (s.monthly_enabled AND g.monthly_enabled)

SELECT r.kind,r.event_key,r.start_date,r.end_date,r.source_name,r.created_at,t.id AS task_id,t.status AS task_status FROM agent_trigger_runs r LEFT JOIN agent_tasks t ON t.id=r.task_id AND t.user_id=r.user_id WHERE r.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC,r.task_id DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_trigger_runs WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND kind=#{kind} AND start_date=#{start} AND end_date=#{end})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications(user_id,kind,event_key,title,body,target) VALUES(#{userId},'AUTO_TASK',#{taskId},'主动任务已创建', CASE #{kind} WHEN 'WEEKLY_REVIEW' THEN '每周睡眠复盘任务已进入任务中心。' WHEN 'MONTHLY_REVIEW' THEN '每月睡眠复盘任务已进入任务中心。' ELSE '睡眠导入后的分析任务已进入任务中心。' END, CONCAT('/agent?task=',#{taskId}))
